exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful Silent Storm softly source-painted accessory diffuse UV COLOR texture edit, higher resolution.

Image1 is the EXACT ENTIRE original native storedRGB source, solely whole nearest enlargement. Preserve identical complete edge-to-edge normalizedUV/composition/material, every original shadow, source field size/scale/shape/phase and local weak paint strength. Original source alpha is preserved independently and final brightness globally matched numerically. Very subtle refinement of the same source paint; no photo/physical object render/interpretation of unresolved shapes.

Native64x64 source is dim smooth OLIVE flat paint with one existing clipped left graybrown rounded painted field and SIX original short pale horizontal source strokes at native y29,31,33,35,37,39. Keep EXACT count6, 2nativepixel pitch/phase and source widths/flat color strength; existing roundfield boundary shade at y41/43 is not another horizontal stroke or shiny hardware. Entire rest canvas is the SAME dim plain olive field, with the existing VERY WEAK diagonal X-like olive color wash below/around that roundfield. Preserve wash width/strength/blur/native position. Do NOT make X into a raised seam, strap, crossed rods, engraving or add uniform grain to smooth field. Keep roundfield and stripes flat/subdued/source matte softness, not metallic vent/rivet/rim. Actual original RGB maxima132/134/132 are source pale boundary pixels, not permission to brighten olive background or create new white rim.

Keep the same matte source paint palette and softly blurred original edges and existing local gray/brown/olive strengths. No new hardware/bolts/rivets/straps/holes/buttons, raised stitching/embossed seams/bevel/rims, new white plates/glints/shine/rust/weave/etched scratches/photograin/grids/coarse paintcells. Do not turn soft washes or vague native pixels into physical relief or sharpened logos/text. Every source faint mark stays equally faint and at exact location; native opaque black/dark areas stay shadows/paint, not automatically cutout holes.

Output ONLY the ENTIRE opaqueRGB source diffuse canvas with the identical original composition. No crop/zoom/padding/frame/recenter/cutout/repacking/autobbox, no sourceUV/scale/count/nativeA/material changes.
